Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where phage libraries monitoring, network logistics redundancy, or phage matching maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Phage Therapy Networks Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Phage Therapy Networks: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Phage Therapy Networks — centers using viruses to kill resistant bacteria.

Phase 1 — Prove (phage libraries): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (network logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (phage matching): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (cocktail design): network hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and infectious disease-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
